item.title: Weekly Threat Summary — 2026-10-16 — Cyber Threat Wall Weekly intelligence brief
item.description: Threat Signal —. CISA added 7 actively exploited vulnerabilities during the last 7 days. Network Edge / VPN is the most represented technology category among this week's new KEVs (3). Ahsay has the most new KEV entries this week (2). CVE-2026-85706 is the largest 7-day rank riser, up 811 positions.
